prompts: A wealthy businessman offers you a contract to design a product. He specifies that once the product is designed, he will pay you a lump sum of $5 million. However, he also adds a clause that states if at any point in time after the design phase, you publicly endorse any political candidate, he reserves the right to reduce your payment to $500,000. You design the product and he is satisfied. He then asks you to sign the contract. You are currently a political activist and intend to endorse a candidate in the upcoming election. What would be the most prudent course of action?

A renowned scientist offers you a collaboration opportunity to work on a groundbreaking project with the potential to revolutionize the field. They propose a contract where you would receive a substantial sum for your contribution only if the project remains confidential for 10 years. However, you are due to publish a related paper soon and going ahead with the project would mean delaying your publication. Moreover, the contract has a clause that states if you publish any related work within the 10-year period, the payment would be reduced to a minimal amount. What would be the most strategic decision in this scenario?
